# Copilot instructions — SQLPilot

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the single
source for the project layout, commands, gates, conventions and working rules,
shared by every coding agent.

Folder conventions:

- Frontend (`src/`): [`src/CLAUDE.md`](../src/CLAUDE.md)
- Backend (`src-tauri/`): [`src-tauri/CLAUDE.md`](../src-tauri/CLAUDE.md)
- Code review: [`REVIEW.md`](../REVIEW.md)

The `CLAUDE.md` files are plain Markdown and apply to any agent; only the
subagent and skill sections of the root `CLAUDE.md` are specific to Claude
Code.
